name: Nem nam Giao Thuy
summary: Nem nắm Giao Thủy is fermented pork. Dân Việt on 5 September 2025 spells it nem mắm. The Nam Định city portal and Vườn quốc gia Xuân Thủy spell it nem nắm. Both spellings stay. VnExpress says you loosen the ball and roll it in lá sung, or dip it in fish sauce. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Giao Thủy, and Hải Hậu on the Nam Định city portal on 17 October 2018. Báo Nam Định on 30 January 2023 says this nem and bánh cuốn làng Kênh were ranked in a Top 100 of Vietnamese dishes. Vườn quốc gia Xuân Thủy’s overnight route includes a stop to see it made.
texture: VnExpress on 18 March 2016: the meat is worked while it is still hot, not set on the ground and not washed in cold water, or it loses its chew. Lean meat is boiled just done or still a little rare, sliced thin along the grain, and pounded with the spine of a knife. Skin is scraped with hot water, boiled, sliced thin, long, and even, then rolled into a ball.
taste: Thế giới tiếp thị on 12 September 2022 adds thính from fragrant gạo tám, mixed with seasoning, and says to loosen the ball into lá sung and đinh lăng and dip it in fish sauce. The lá sung roll and the direct fish-sauce dip on VnExpress both stay.
howToEat: Loosen the ball. Roll it in lá sung, or in lá sung and đinh lăng, or dip it in fish sauce. A clock was not printed. Check on arrival. A price is Check on arrival.
where: Giao Thủy, and Hải Hậu on the Nam Định city portal. A door was not printed. Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Nem nam Giao Thuy — both spellings stay
seoDescription: Fermented pork of Giao Thủy. Nem nắm and nem mắm both stay. Loosen the ball into lá sung or dip it in fish sauce. A price is Check on arrival.
